title: Jensen Huang scandal
paragraphs: On October 29, 2026, The New York Times reported that Jensen Huang, the co-founder and CEO of Nvidia, had been the target of a spy plot involving the government of China, citing people briefed on U.S. intelligence surveillance who spoke on condition of anonymity. Huang had an extramarital affair with Alice Huang (no relation), a Chinese national who was an executive of Megaspeed, a Singaporean company. U.S. officials reportedly suspected that she had been recruited by China's Ministry of State Security as a spy. On November 11, The New York Times reported, citing five Nvidia employees, that Jensen Huang had also had an extramarital relationship with Kimberly Powell, an executive who reported to him. That same day, Nvidia's board met to discuss his ouster and accepted his resignation, which the company announced the following day.

President Donald Trump was briefed on the intelligence in 2025 and in May 2026, and chose not to act. U.S. officials did not warn Jensen Huang through a defensive briefing. On November 12, Attorney General Todd Blanche said the Justice Department had reached no conclusion about whether Alice Huang was a spy, and CNN reported, citing multiple sources, that the intelligence collected on her did not prove she had acted as one. The next day, the Times reported that multiple people who had reviewed the underlying U.S. intelligence stated that they were confident in their information about her interactions with Chinese intelligence and believed she was an "asset" rather than a trained intelligence officer, and that the investigations were still ongoing. On November 16, Trump said he did not know whether she was a spy. On November 24, U.S. intelligence officials told congressional staff that there was no evidence the ministry had directed her to begin the affair or to spy on Jensen Huang; According to The Wall Street Journal, China's spy agency approached Alice Huang to provide them with information as required under Chinese law, but there was no indication that she had disclosed significant intelligence.

questions.q: What is the main topic of the text?
options: The resignation of Nvidia's CEO following reports of affair allegations and spy investigations
The official trade agreements reached between the U.S. government and Nvidia executives
A confirmed plot by Chinese intelligence to take over Nvidia's daily operations
A conflict between President Donald Trump and the U.S. Justice Department over law enforcement
questions.evidence: On October 29, 2026, The New York Times reported that Jensen Huang, the co-founder and CEO of Nvidia, had been the target of a spy plot involving the government of China, citing people briefed on U.S. intelligence surveillance who spoke on condition of anonymity.
questions.why: 文章主要報導輝達執行長黃仁勳因涉及婚外情及潛在的中國間諜調查爭議，最終導致其辭職的事件。

options: He disclosed top-secret company intelligence to Alice Huang
He had an extramarital relationship with an executive who reported to him
The Justice Department officially charged him with espionage
President Donald Trump personally instructed the company board to remove him
questions.evidence: On November 11, The New York Times reported, citing five Nvidia employees, that Jensen Huang had also had an extramarital relationship with Kimberly Powell, an executive who reported to him. That same day, Nvidia's board met to discuss his ouster and accepted his resignation, which the company announced the following day.
questions.why: 根據文本，董事會在報導指出黃仁勳與其下屬主管金柏莉·鮑威爾有婚外情後開會討論並接受了他的辭職。
